resting-dark.$description: Dark-mode companion to shadow.resting — Theme Runtime Chunk 07. Retuned alpha, not just a copy: a pure-black shadow reads almost nothing against an already near-black surface (neutral-dark.1 sits at OKLCH L≈0.15 — there's little room left to darken further, verified by computing the actual composited lightness delta at several alphas rather than guessing). 35% alpha lands the perceptible delta in the same range as an adjacent primitive scale step (~0.02-0.03 L).
